convention.view: side view, athlete faces +X (right); angles in radians, 0 = limb hanging straight down, +π/2 = horizontal forward, ±π = straight up

joints.lean: torso pitch around the hip, + forward
joints.fF: front FOREARM absolute angle (elbow = fF - aF)

convention.unit: u = body height / 10 (the 2D avatar is 10 u tall)
